meta.title: Edit Quote updates vendor global fields such as taxes or delivery terms

steps.note: Open an existing published event with a vendor quote, as required by the setup.
Navigate to the vendor comparison view where the quote and vendor menu are available.

args.goal: In the buyer's Responses comparison view, open the three-dot menu next to the vendor's name, select Edit Quote, update one available vendor global field such as taxes or delivery terms, save it, and stop on the comparison view showing the edited value.

steps.note: No catalog step directly performs Edit Quote or verifies an arbitrary edited global field, so this buyer-side screen action must be worked out and evidenced on screen.
Confirm the resulting comparison view has no application error, crash, raw identifiers, or invalid values.
